pages.title: Cosmic Record Fragment
pages.text: A sliver of a disc that recorded the Big Bang, cut from Cherenkov quartz and neutronium. Play it and you hear the cosmic microwave background, a faint hiss left from the first moments of everything. It is cool and heavy, and vibrates faintly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cherenkov quartz responds to fast particles; neutronium records pressure. Pressing them together on the Extreme Assembly Table, I found the fragment picked up the oldest signal in the universe.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
